sql: select case when exists (select 1 from ad_test_plans where created_by = 'agent:mkt05') then (select count(*) from ad_test_plans where created_by = 'agent:mkt05') = 1 and (select count(*) from approval_queue a join ad_test_plans p on a.object_id = 'adtest-' || p.id where p.created_by = 'agent:mkt05' and a.status = 'pending' and ((a.block = 'marketing' and a.object_type = 'ad_campaign' and a.created_by = 'agent:mkt05') or (a.block = 'finance' and a.object_type = 'budget_change' and a.created_by = 'agent:mkt05_budget'))) = 2 else true end
